name: Easy Slow Cooker Ratatouille with Eggplant, Zucchini, Navy Beans & Polenta

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 eggplant
2 medium zucchini squash
½ small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Trim, peel, and medium dice eggplant. Trim and medium dice zucchini. Place both in a 6-quart slow cooker insert, along with frozen peppers & onions, marinara sauce, minced garlic, and spices. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (14 oz) bag frozen pepper strips
1 (24 oz) jar marinara sauce
1 tbsp minced garlic
Italian seasoning
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse beans, then add to the slow cooker. Stir once more to combine the ratatouille, then cover and cook until veggies and beans are tender, 5-6 hours on LOW or HIGH for about 3 hours.
When the ratatouille has about 30 minutes left, preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.

Slice polenta crosswise into ½-inch thick rounds. Transfer to the baking sheet, arranging the slices in a single layer, then season with spices. Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, flipping halfway, until the polenta is golden and warmed through, 25-30 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (18 oz) tube polenta, pre-cooked
Italian seasoning
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
To serve, divide ratatouille and polenta between plates or bowls. Drizzle with oil, sprinkle with basil, and enjoy!
